name: moru
description: Coordinate and verify multi-step Codex work using project context.

interface.shortDescription: Run and verify multi-step project work.
interface.longDescription: Moru reads optional project guidance from MORU.md, selects available skills and tools for each part of a request, and reports the work with verification results. It follows the scope and permissions stated by the user.
defaultPrompt: Use $moru to complete this request and verify the result.
Use $moru to implement this change and run the relevant checks.
Use $moru to review this work without modifying it.
